events.gate_note: eew/alert use the live engine's numeric quality gates (GATES), but replayed observed-PGA timing is approximate: a station's record-peak counts once its S-window has passed — not the causally-observed running PGA the live engine uses
events.report_md:
台灣時間 2026年8月13日 凌晨3時54分，台灣南部海域（北緯 21.88 度，東經 120.71 度）發生一起深 40.2 公里的地震，中央氣象署測得規模為 4.4。在 EdgeQuake 離線重播中，系統於發震後 7.5 秒產出首次定位，並於發震後 14.3 秒估算首次規模為 8.19，隨後演進至最終規模 5.37，最終震央定位誤差為 71.9 公里。依據 WorldPop 2026 R2025A 人口資料與點源及平均地表場址放大假設，預估約 519431 人可能感受到震度3以上搖晃。

系統於發震後 15.5 秒達到強震即時警報發布標準。15.5 秒為未納入系統延遲的理論下界，不可與官方發布時間直接比較。PWS 國家級警報未觸發：規模與預估震度條件曾於重播中達成（規模最高 M8.19），但該時段內實測 PGA 最高 18.1 gal，未達 25 gal 門檻。歷史上最相似的事件為 1983-02-26T02:05 發生於 52 km NE of Hengchun, Taiwan 的 5.1 級地震。本報告為學術研究原型系統之自動化重播結果，並非官方發布之地震資訊。

---

At 03:54 local time on August 13, 2026, a magnitude 4.4 earthquake occurred in the southern offshore region of Taiwan (21.88 N, 120.71 E) at a depth of 40.2 km. In the EdgeQuake post-hoc replay, the engine produced its first location at origin+7.5 s and its first magnitude of 8.19 at origin+14.3 s, which evolved to a final magnitude of 5.37, with a final epicenter error of 71.9 km. Based on WorldPop 2026 R2025A and a point-source/average-site assumption, an estimated ~519431 people may have felt intensity-3+ shaking.

The EEW issuance criteria were met at origin+15.5 s. The 15.5 s figure is a theoretical lower bound that excludes system latency and must not be compared directly with official issuance times. The PWS public alert did not trigger: the magnitude/intensity rule was met during the replay (magnitude peaked at M8.19), but the highest observed PGA in those frames was 18.1 gal, below the 25 gal threshold. The most similar historical event was the 1983-02-26T02:05 earthquake of magnitude 5.1 located 52 km NE of Hengchun, Taiwan. This is an automated report from a research-prototype system, not official information.

台灣時間 2026 年 7 月 31 日凌晨 0 時 58 分，台灣東部海域（北緯 23.1 度、東經 121.36 度）發生深度 20.2 公里的 4.7 規模地震。在 EdgeQuake 系統的震後回放模擬中，發震後 4.9 秒完成首次定位，發震後 9.2 秒估算首次規模為 5.88，隨後收斂至最終規模 4.81，震央定位誤差為 17.4 公里。

9.2 秒為未納入系統延遲的理論下界，不可與官方發布時間直接比較。PWS 國家級警報未觸發：規模與預估震度組合從未達到發布條件（M≥5.0 且縣市預估震度≥4 級，或 M≥6.5 且≥3 級）；重播期間規模估計最高 M5.94、預估縣市震度最高 3 級（兩極值未必同時出現）。依據 WorldPop 2026 R2025A 數據，在假設點源與平均地表條件下，預估約 44040 人可能感受到震度3以上搖晃。此事件與 1980 年 4 月 2 日於玉井東方 95 公里處發生的規模 5.0 地震最為相似。本報告為自動化研究原型系統產出，非官方正式強震即時警報。

---

On July 31, 2026, at 00:58 local time, a magnitude 4.7 earthquake struck off the coast of Taiwan (23.1°N, 121.36°E) at a depth of 20.2 km. In this post-hoc replay, the EdgeQuake engine achieved its first location at origin+4.9 s. The first magnitude estimate of 5.88 was resolved at origin+9.2 s, which later stabilized at a final magnitude of 4.81, resulting in an epicenter error of 17.4 km.

The 9.2 s figure is a theoretical lower bound that excludes system latency and must not be compared directly with official issuance times. The PWS public alert did not trigger: the magnitude/intensity rule ((M>=5.0 & county intensity>=4) or (M>=6.5 & >=3)) was never met in any single instant — the magnitude estimate peaked at M5.94 and the highest predicted county intensity was 3 (these extremes need not be simultaneous). Based on the WorldPop 2026 R2025A dataset, assuming a point-source and average-site conditions, an estimated ~44040 people may have felt intensity-3+ shaking. This event is seismically most similar to the April 2, 1980 earthquake of magnitude 5.0 located 95 km E of Yujing. This is an automated report from a research prototype, not an official warning.

provenance.original_run_note: the original live Actions run (2026-07-31) used the then-deployed pre-CANONICAL code — before run-parameter single-sourcing and site corrections — and its log reports first magnitude M6.2 / 43 km. The log is retained verbatim as historical evidence and is superseded by this record.
provenance.recompute_verification: the numeric fields of this record are re-derived from the replay artifact at every results_summary generation and cross-checked field by field (audit_cross_check in results_summary.json); generation aborts on any mismatch, and --verify fails unless the cross-check status is 'match' and the record hash is unchanged since.
